description: Pure logic layer for the guided-cast flow (no React): additive non-behavioural helpers in src/logic/spell-casting.ts (plus stale-citation fixes), and the new src/logic/guided-cast/ module (types, pure reducer, sync advisor) with full unit + property tests. This is the foundation FEAT-003 reads flags off and FEAT-002's seam delivers results into. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that they depend on it.
steps: In src/logic/spell-casting.ts add pure `computeCastingTargetBreakdown(character): { intTotal: number; advances: number; total: number }` returning Int total (i+a+b) and Language (Magick) advances, and refactor `computeCastingTarget` to `return computeCastingTargetBreakdown(character).total` so the result is byte-for-byte identical. Add citation comment `// Core p.234: Casting Test — Int total + Language (Magick) advances`.
In src/logic/spell-casting.ts add pure `isPettySpell(spell: SpellItem): boolean` = `spell.cn === '0' || spell.cn === '-'` (single source for the Petty rule).

In src/logic/spell-casting.ts add pure `computeOvercastBudgetBreakdown(result: CastingResult): { slAchieved: number; totalPowerTens: number; cn: number; overcastSlots: number }` where `totalPowerTens = Math.max(0, result.overcastSlots + result.cn - result.slAchieved)` (do NOT re-derive tensDigit(roll)). Add comment `// Winds of Magic §"Critical Casting" (Total Power) — add the tens digit of the casting roll to SL for Overcasting (see WoM p.23 Overcast Table)`.

In src/logic/spell-casting.ts correct the stale citation comments in the resolveCastingResult area: change `Total Power (Winds of Magic p.19): ...` to reference `Winds of Magic §"Critical Casting" (Total Power) ... (see WoM p.23 Overcast Table)`, and change `Channelled cast failure (Winds of Magic p.20): ...` to `Winds of Magic §"Channelling Test" — failed channelled cast forces a Minor Miscast`. Content only; no behaviour change.

Add unit tests in src/logic/__tests__/spell-casting.breakdown.test.ts: breakdown lines sum to computeCastingTarget; isPettySpell true for '0'/'-' and false otherwise; computeOvercastBudgetBreakdown gives totalPowerTens 0 in the normal case and positive under a Total-Power re-resolve, and slAchieved + totalPowerTens - cn === overcastSlots.

Create src/logic/guided-cast/types.ts (React-free): CastStep = 'select'|'route'|'resolve'|'overcast'|'miscast'|'outcome'; CastRoute = 'cast'|'channel'|null; GuidedCastState { step; spellName: string|null; route: CastRoute; result: CastingResult|null; overcastDone: boolean; overcastAllocations: Record<string,number>|null; miscastDone: boolean }; GuidedCastEvent discriminated union { start; spellName } | { next } | { back } | { goto; step } | { chooseRoute; route } | { castResolved; result } | { overcastResolved; allocations } | { miscastCompleted } | { reset }; CastStepInfo { step; title; body; citation }; CastAdvisorSource { describe(step, ctx): CastStepInfo | Promise<CastStepInfo> }. Import CastingResult as a type from '../spell-casting'; no React import.

Create src/logic/guided-cast/reducer.ts exporting STEP_SEQUENCE, initialGuidedCastState, applicableSteps(state) (overcast iff result.castSuccess && result.overcastSlots > 0; miscast iff result.triggerMinorMiscast || result.triggerMajorMiscast), applicableIndex(state), and guidedCastReducer(state, event). next/back index into applicableSteps and clamp; goto no-op unless target is applicable; chooseRoute sets route without changing step; castResolved stores result, resets overcastDone/miscastDone/overcastAllocations, then clamps step to the nearest still-applicable step per the design snippet; overcastResolved stores allocations + sets overcastDone without changing step; miscastCompleted sets miscastDone without changing step; reset returns fresh initial state. Pure, total, never throws, never mutates input.

Create src/logic/guided-cast/steps.ts with describeCastStep(step, ctx: { isPetty: boolean; route: CastRoute }) returning static rulebook-cited copy for all six steps, and `export const defaultCastAdvisor: CastAdvisorSource = { describe: describeCastStep }`. Citations: Casting Test Core p.234; Channelling Core p.237 + WoM §Channelling Test; Critical/Fumbled Core p.234-235 + WoM §Critical Casting/§Fumbled Casting; Overcasting Core p.238 superseded by WoM Overcast Table p.23; Miscast tables Core p.234-235. Step 2 copy separates the Core p.234 cast/CN cite from the app-convention Petty-no-channel clause (derived from isPettySpell). No network/LLM/telemetry.

Add src/logic/guided-cast/__tests__/reducer.test.ts mirroring src/logic/combat-turn/__tests__/reducer.test.ts — assert the transition rules incl. next from resolve lands on overcast when applicable else outcome, goto-inapplicable no-op, and castResolved clamp-to-nearest-applicable (on overcast, re-resolve zeroing overcastSlots clamps to resolve).

Add src/logic/guided-cast/__tests__/reducer.property.test.ts (fast-check) porting the combat-turn property suite: step ∈ STEP_SEQUENCE; step ∈ applicableSteps; next-then-back round-trip over the applicable subset; reset deep-equals initial; overcastResolved/miscastCompleted never change step; never throws on frozen input; pure function of (state, event). Arbitraries cover every CastStep, CastRoute, and representative CastingResult flag combinations.
Add src/logic/guided-cast/__tests__/steps.test.ts: defaultCastAdvisor.describe returns a non-Promise for every step; citation strings match the exact rulebook pages; no invented TN/cost in copy.
acceptance_criteria: computeCastingTarget returns the same value as before (existing spell-casting tests pass unchanged) and computeCastingTargetBreakdown lines sum to it.
The three new helpers and the stale-citation fixes are present; no runtime behaviour of spell-casting.ts changed.
guidedCastReducer is pure/total/deterministic, never throws, never mutates input (property tests assert this).
applicableSteps includes overcast iff castSuccess && overcastSlots > 0 and miscast iff a trigger flag is set; navigation and clamping operate over the applicable subset.
defaultCastAdvisor is synchronous in v1 and makes no network/LLM/telemetry call; citations match the cited pages.
Running `npx vitest --run src/logic/guided-cast src/logic/__tests__/spell-casting.breakdown.test.ts` passes all new tests, and existing spell-casting suites pass unchanged.
verification: npx vitest --run src/logic/guided-cast src/logic/__tests__  (all new tests pass; existing spell-casting tests unchanged)
npx eslint src/logic/guided-cast src/logic/spell-casting.ts  (0 errors, no new warnings)
findings:
Done & committed on the current branch. Full gate clean: tsc --build --force --noEmit exit 0; npm run build succeeds; npx vitest --run 5470/5470 pass across 506 files (existing suites unchanged, 33 new tests added); npx eslint . 0 errors + only the 3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings (CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx) — no new warnings, no eslint-disable added.

API surface FEAT-002/003 depend on:
- src/logic/spell-casting.ts (additive, non-behavioural): computeCastingTargetBreakdown(character) -> { intTotal, advances, total }; computeCastingTarget now delegates to .total (byte-for-byte identical, cite Core p.234). isPettySpell(spell) -> boolean ('0' | '-'). computeOvercastBudgetBreakdown(result) -> { slAchieved, totalPowerTens, cn, overcastSlots } where totalPowerTens = max(0, overcastSlots + cn - slAchieved) (no tensDigit re-derive; cite WoM Critical Casting/Total Power, WoM p.23). Stale WoM p.19/p.20 comments corrected to WoM Critical Casting (p.23) / WoM Channelling Test.
- src/logic/guided-cast/types.ts: CastStep ('select'|'route'|'resolve'|'overcast'|'miscast'|'outcome'); CastRoute ('cast'|'channel'|null); GuidedCastState; GuidedCastEvent discriminated union; CastStepInfo; CastAdvisorSource (sync/async-union, describe(step, {isPetty, route})). CastingResult imported type-only from ../spell-casting; no React import.
- src/logic/guided-cast/reducer.ts: STEP_SEQUENCE (all six, overcast/miscast are conditional), initialGuidedCastState, applicableSteps(state) (overcast iff castSuccess && overcastSlots>0; miscast iff triggerMinorMiscast||triggerMajorMiscast), applicableIndex(state), guidedCastReducer(state,event) — pure/total/never-throws/never-mutates; next/back index the applicable subset & clamp; goto no-op unless target applicable; castResolved resets overcast/miscast flags+allocations and clamps step to nearest prior applicable step.
- src/logic/guided-cast/steps.ts: describeCastStep(step, {isPetty, route}) static cited copy; defaultCastAdvisor: CastAdvisorSource = { describe: describeCastStep }. Step 2 (route) separates the Core p.234 cast/CN cite from the app-convention 'Petty (CN 0) cannot be channelled' clause (added only when isPetty). No LLM/network/telemetry.

Notes for FEAT-002 (the panel seam): the reducer owns overcast capture via { kind:'overcastResolved'; allocations } and miscast completion via { kind:'miscastCompleted' } (neither changes step); castResolved must be dispatched at ALL THREE non-null setCastingResult sites per design (initial resolve + total_power + unstoppable_force re-resolves) — critical_wound branch does NOT re-resolve so must NOT fire it. The handle has no result read-back; result enters the guide only via the push callback. Skill shape is {n,c,a} (c not ch); RollResult has the full dice-roller shape (targetNumber/baseTarget/difficulty/outcome/skillOrCharName/timestamp, no isDouble field).
